request.message: I've had a fever for 3 days with a bad headache, and I got bitten by mosquitoes last week

response.message:
Salamat sa pag-share nito. Yung kombinasyon ng lagnat na 3 araw na, matinding sakit ng ulo, at yung history ng kagat ng lamok — lalo na't may active dengue advisory sa inyong lugar — ay mga senyales na dapat seryosohin. Pwedeng ordinaryong trangkaso lang ito, pero pwede ring dengue o ibang viral na sakit. Hindi natin masisiguro sa chat lang dahil kailangan ng physical exam at posibleng blood test para malaman ang dahilan.

Mas mabuting magpa-check ka na sa doktor ngayong araw o bukas. Importante ito dahil sa dengue, minsan pagbaba ng lagnat ay doon pa lumalabas ang mga delikadong sintomas, kaya kailangang mabantayan ka nang maigi.
response.explanation: Ang lagnat na 3 araw na, matinding sakit ng ulo, at exposure sa kagat ng lamok sa gitna ng dengue advisory ay nangangailangan ng pagsusuri ng doktor sa loob ng 24-48 oras.
response.next_step: Magpa-check sa doktor ngayong araw o bukas; sabihin mo: 'May lagnat ako ng 3 araw, matinding sakit ng ulo, at nakagat ako ng maraming lamok noong nakaraang linggo.'
self_care: Uminom ng maraming tubig o fluids
Paracetamol para sa lagnat kung kailangan, ayon sa label ng gamot
monitoring: Bantayan ang pakiramdam kahit gumaan ang lagnat
Obserbahan kung may lalabas na pantal o pagdurugo
response.encouragement: Nandito lang ako — kung may mapansin kang bago o lumala ang pakiramdam mo, sabihin mo agad at titingnan natin kung kailangan nang mag-seek care now.

request.message: My dog bit me this morning and now I'm feeling feverish and weak

response.message:
I'm sorry to hear about the bite. Because you are feeling feverish and weak just hours after a dog bite, this is something that needs to be checked by a doctor right away. While it could be a reaction to the injury, we have to be careful about the risk of infection or other complications that can come from animal bites. I cannot examine the wound or check your health status here, so please head to an emergency room or a clinic that can see you today.

When you arrive, tell them: "I was bitten by a dog this morning and I am now feeling feverish and weak."
response.explanation: A dog bite followed by systemic symptoms like fever and weakness requires immediate medical evaluation to assess for infection and the need for rabies or tetanus prophylaxis.
watch_for: Spreading redness, warmth, or swelling around the bite
Increased pain or pus from the wound
response.next_step: Go to an emergency room or clinic immediately.
response.encouragement: Please get to a doctor as soon as you can — I am here if you have any other questions while you are on your way.
